tool.name: sincei scPlotRegion
tool.description: plot single-cell signal and pseudo-bulk profile in a region
tool.command: scPlotRegion --input '$input' --region '$region' --outFile '$plot' --outFileFormat '$outFileFormat' --mode '$mode' #if str($plot_options.signalMin) not in ('', 'None'): --signalMin $plot_options.signalMin #end if #if str($plot_options.signalMax) not in ('', 'None'): --signalMax $plot_options.signalMax #end if #if str($plot_options.hmapMin) not in ('', 'None'): --hmapMin $plot_options.hmapMin #end if #if str($plot_options.hmapMax) not in ('', 'None'): --hmapMax $plot_options.hmapMax #end if --summaryPlotColor '$plot_options.summaryPlotColor' --colorMap '$plot_options.colorMap' --figsize $plot_options.width $plot_options.height --dpi $plot_options.dpi

param.label: Region
param.help: Genomic region in CHROM:START-END format, e.g. chr1:23365000-23375000.

param.label: Mode
param.help: How to aggregate signal for plotting the summary profiles (pseudobulk) on top.

param.label: Signal minimum
param.help: Minimum value for the pseudobulk summary profile. Default: minimum signal in the region.

param.label: Signal maximum
param.help: Maximum value for the pseudobulk summary profile. Default: maximum signal in the region.

param.label: Heatmap minimum
param.help: Minimum value for single-cell heatmap signal. Default: minimum signal in the region.

param.label: Heatmap maximum
param.help: Maximum value for single-cell heatmap signal. Default: maximum signal in the region.

param.label: Summary plot color
param.help: Color for the pseudobulk summary profile plot.

param.label: Colormap
param.help: Colormap for heatmap. Must be a valid matplotlib colormap entry, e.g. Reds, viridis, Blues.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scPlotRegion` plots the signal of every cell in a genomic region as a heatmap, in the style of a genome browser track, with the aggregated pseudo-bulk profile on top.
-----
**Inputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) count matrix with genomic regions as variables, e.g. from `scCountReads bins`. - A region, as `chrom:start-end`.
**Outputs**
- An image (PNG, PDF or SVG). @HELP_FOOTER@
